old: अब मैं इस महान् के महान् और सच्चे कार्य, उस सत्य के कर्म, अवश्य कहूँगा। त्रिकद्रुकों में उसने निचोड़े हुए इस सोम को पिया; उसके मद में इन्द्र ने अहि को मारा।
new: अब मैं इस महान् के महान् और सच्चे कृत्य, उस सत्य के कृत्य, अवश्य कहूँगा। त्रिकद्रुकों में उसने निचोड़े हुए इस सोम को पिया; उसके मद में इन्द्र ने अहि को मारा।
why: reviewer (minor): karaṇāni is rendered 'deeds'; the notes say Hindi uses कृत्य, but the Hindi has कार्य (reserved for apas) and कर्म (reserved for karma = action). Use कृत्य as the notes state.

old: trikadruka: a word of uncertain sense, kept as a name ('the Trikadrukas'). 'asya' with sutasya read as 'of this (Soma)'. The Hindi uses कृत्य for 'deeds' of the true one.
new: trikadruka: a word of uncertain sense, kept as a name ('the Trikadrukas'). 'asya' with sutasya read as 'of this (Soma)'. The Hindi uses कृत्य for 'deeds' of the true one. 'Soma' is supplied in the translation: the line has only 'of this pressed (drink)' (sutasya asya) and 'its' exhilaration.
why: reviewer (minor): 'Soma' is not in the line; supplied noun is presented as plain translation, so the notes should say so.
reviewer (minor): 'ā' is glossed 'forth' and the note takes it with dyām; the idiom is ā ... apṛṇat ('filled'), as both translations treat it. Gloss and note contradict the translation.

old: avaṃśe: 'without a support' (locative of a rare word); sense uncertain. 'bṛhantam ā' taken with 'dyām'.
new: avaṃśe: 'without a support' (locative of a rare word); sense uncertain. 'bṛhantam ā' taken with 'dyām'. Correction: ā is a preverb with apṛṇat (ā ... apṛṇat, 'filled'), not with dyām; bṛhantam agrees with dyām.
why: reviewer (minor): The note 'bṛhantam ā taken with dyām' disagrees with the translation.

new: उसने अपनी महिमा से ऊपर बहने वाली नदी को छोड़ा; वज्र से उषा के शकट को चूर-चूर कर दिया। वह धीमों को तेज़ वालों से काटता गया। सोम के मद में इन्द्र ने वे कार्य किए।
why: reviewer (minor): anas is a cart/wagon ('cart' in the English); 'रथ' is the chariot (ratha) and blurs two different words.

old: Having strewn them over with sleep, you slew Cumuri and Dhuni, the Dasyu, and you helped Dabhīti. Even the staff-bearer found gold here. In the exhilaration of Soma, Indra did those deeds.
new: Having strewn over with sleep, you slew Cumuri and Dhuni, the Dasyu, and you helped Dabhīti. Even the staff-bearer found gold here. In the exhilaration of Soma, Indra did those deeds.
why: reviewer (minor): 'them' (the object of abhyupya) is not in the line, nor in the Hindi.

old: Now may that bountiful gift of yours, Indra, yield a boon in return for the singer. Give to the praisers; let our share not burn away. May we, rich in heroes, speak loudly at the rite.
new: Now may that bountiful gift of yours, Indra, yield a boon in return for the singer. Give to the praisers; do not burn beyond; the share is ours. May we, rich in heroes, speak loudly at the rite.
why: reviewer (minor): Fixed rendering in the glossary for this refrain pāda: bhaga = share, mā ati dhak = 'do not burn beyond'.
